purpose: Self-contained runtime inputs for `python -m models.suitability.infer --region <region-id>` (full-region and sub-area queries). Shown here for jo-maan (~1.13 GB); every governorate has its own window built by scripts/build_governorate.ps1. Too large for the repository; NOT needed to serve the committed results or for models/suitability/examples/run_example.* (uses sample_data).
location_logical: <GREEN_NOVA_M1_RUNTIME> (default: <GREEN_NOVA_DATA>/runtime/model1; GREEN_NOVA_DATA names a data folder outside the repository; override the runtime location with env GREEN_NOVA_M1_RUNTIME)
features_npy: float32 memmap (47 layers x 2311 rows x 2607 cols) on the 100 m EPSG:6933 grid; layer names in meta.json 'layers'
copy_to_new_machine: Copy the whole folder, set GREEN_NOVA_M1_RUNTIME to it, verify sha256 of each file above.

rebuild.needs: the build cache <GREEN_NOVA_DATA>/cache/model1/stack (100 m Jordan layers) which itself needs internet access to Planetary Computer, ISRIC, Geofabrik, ucdavis.edu (hours; see docs/DATA_SOURCES_model1.md)
commands: python -m models.suitability.acquire_static dem soilgrids worldclim gsw  (+ tc_ppt tc_pet tc_tmax tc_tmin tc_def tc_aet in parallel, then: acquire_static terraclimate)
python -m models.suitability.acquire_labels wc ; python -m models.suitability.acquire_labels io
python -m models.suitability.acquire_vectors sotwis ; python -m models.suitability.acquire_vectors osm
python -m models.suitability.terrain ; python -m models.suitability.build_stack ; python -m models.suitability.labels
python -m models.suitability.package_runtime --region jo-maan   (writes the folder described above)
